input: Run a KYC screen on Greensill Capital in the United Kingdom

registration.registered_address: C/O Grant Thornton Uk Advisory & Tax Llp, 11th Floor Landmark St Peters Square, 1 Oxford Street, Manchester, M1 4PB

people.name: Mr Alexander David Greensill
people.role: Person with significant control — has significant influence or control over the trustees of a trust

pep.name: Bill Crothers
pep.position: Potential PEP: former Government Chief Commercial Officer, Cabinet Office; former director of Greensill Capital

adverse_media.summary: The UK Insolvency Service said Lex Greensill accepted a nine-year disqualification undertaking after conduct involving Greensill Capital (UK) Limited breached his Companies Act 2006 duty to exercise reasonable care, skill and diligence; the undertaking concerned transactions involving Katerra and a $440 million loss to a Credit Suisse fund.
adverse_media.status: Disqualification undertaking accepted; ban effective 2026-06-23 and running until June 2035

adverse_media.category: Suspected fraud, fraudulent trading and money-laundering investigation
adverse_media.summary: The Serious Fraud Office announced an investigation into suspected fraud, fraudulent trading and money laundering concerning GFG Alliance financing and conduct, including financing arrangements with Greensill Capital UK Ltd.

Reuters reported that Zurich's London counterclaim alleged a fraudulent scheme involving Lex Greensill, Greensill Capital UK, Sanjeev Gupta and Liberty businesses, including alleged misrepresentations and non-genuine receivables; Lex Greensill and GFG disputed the allegations.

output.risk_rationale: High risk. The exact UK entity is in administration and the Companies House record identifies an active PSC, while GLEIF identifies LEI 2138004D9J9DZUANAI93 but shows the LEI registration as lapsed even though the entity record is active [1](#cite-1) [2](#cite-2) [4](#cite-4). Lex Greensill, a former director of the entity, accepted a nine-year UK director disqualification after the official finding of a Companies Act duty breach [UK Insolvency Service](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/lex-greensill-to-be-disqualified-from-acting-as-a-company-director-in-the-uk-for-nine-years); the SFO also lists an open investigation into suspected fraud, fraudulent trading and money laundering involving financing arrangements with Greensill Capital UK Ltd [Serious Fraud Office](https://www.gov.uk/sfo-cases/gupta-family-group-gfg-alliance), and Reuters reported a civil counterclaim alleging fraud, with the allegations disputed [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/zurich-draws-lex-greensill-sanjeev-gupta-into-london-court-battle-2024-02-02/). Bill Crothers is a potential PEP because Parliament identifies him as a former Cabinet Office Government Chief Commercial Officer and former Greensill director [UK Parliament](https://publications.parliament.uk/pa/cm5803/cmselect/cmpubadm/888/report.html). OFSI returned zero matches for the entity and screened names, and OFAC returned no exact matches; the 47 OFAC fuzzy results were unrelated namesakes or other unmatched records [5](#cite-5) [6](#cite-6). No Greensill term appeared in the four 500-record EU consolidated-list pages examined, but the EU capability's full result is paginated and its previews were truncated, so that absence is not treated as a definitive full-list clearance [7](#cite-7) [8](#cite-8) [9](#cite-9) [10](#cite-10).
